findings.problem: check_verdicts.py judges only calls that reached echo. A ContextForge call that fails with an error other than GXG_IDENTITY_DENIED (Unknown tool, Tool not found, 5xx) is not a FAIL while the agent has one accepted call on another path; attack_cross_team reached_echo is not checked. Case: both t-beta:hermes virtual_server calls of my upgrade run replaced with 'Unknown tool: echo-t-beta-echo' and their echo rows removed -> 'check_verdicts c-upgrade: OK', exit 0. The M4.json DoD-2 note ('exits 1 if … any ContextForge call not accepted') says more than the script does. Criterion 4 result itself reproduced path by path.

comparison_m4_live: claude/m4-live@b6918a5 reaches the same result for C on all 5 criteria with the same building blocks (PyJWT in the v1.1.1 image, tool_pre_invoke, payload.headers, Ed25519, ahs over the same canonical JSON, 60 s TTL, 5 s leeway). Differences: m4-live pins typ and kid and rejects a duplicate header; echo there answers -32001 on rejection; aud = gateway URL instead of a connector id; no tool claim check; jti cache with expiry and lock. This branch adds a signed tool binding, sub-in-tenant, strict aud, tests + mutmut, and a failing run gate. No contradiction between the two.
